scientific_integrity: Complete all-length proof of sharp exact-two swap optimizer classification and enumeration for alphabets of at least three letters, derived from a local support-partition lemma; exhaustive verification is finite.
scientific_limitations: At-most-two successive swap ball formulas and binary maxima are previously recorded and not claimed as novel. Main claim concerns exact-two operation maximizers and their labeled all-length counts for alphabets of size at least three; a prior implicit derivation remains a priority risk.
title: Complete maximizers of exact-two adjacent-swap spheres over nonbinary alphabets
